short: Tools the Engineer runs by hand
is: Command-line tools the Engineer runs directly, without Claude; review-pr.sh opens a GitHub PR as uncommitted changes in the colocated checkout for a local review.
conventions: Bash like scripts/, each tool with a sibling <name>.test.sh in the scripts/*.test.sh style, run by `just engineer-tools-test`.
A tool keeps its state outside the repo, under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/zurfur/.
Install with `just engineer-tools-install` (to ${XDG_BIN_HOME:-~/.local/bin}) and run the installed `review-pr`: a review rewrites the checkout, and the copy here can vanish mid-review.

fs.name: review-pr.sh
fs.role: local PR review in ~/code/zurfur: a scratch jj change holding the PR head's files; pause keeps typed notes; publish posts the `REVIEW:` notes as one pending GitHub review; stop drops it; never pushes

fs.name: review-pr.test.sh
fs.role: review-pr.sh against a scratch colocated jj checkout with gh stubbed; skips without jj
